text_block_list.text: ...Listen. Can we take a bit of a detour?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hey, do you mind if we go for a short
stroll
around here?

the
academy as per usual when Mejiro
Dober makes a

nod.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Wow! I can't believe such amazing
scenery is so
short a walk off the beaten
track...
choice_data_list: (Is there something she wants to do?)
(Is there something she wants to do?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...
I wonder where we'll end up if we
keep following
this river.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Although this outfit isn't exactly ideal
for walking
on rocky terrain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
choice_data_list: Then shall we turn back here?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...No, I'd like to keep going. We've
already come
this far.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Let's look for a spot with stable footing
and see
how much further we can go.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Whoa, the ocean!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, I know it's only natural that the
river would
connect to the ocean
somewhere, but actually
seeing it... It's
so stunning.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Of course! We decided to go as far as
the path
could take us, right?
choice_data_list: Since we're here, want to go right down to the water's edge?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, it's cold! But it feels really nice!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Oh, look! A group of hermit crabs!
...I
wonder if there's something among those

rocks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It's dim and a bit mysterious... If this
were a film
or a comic, I bet we'd find
something amazing
washed up there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober continues to dart back and
forth
between anything and everything
that piques her
curiosity.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm exhausted... I guess I overdid
it a little
bit.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...And you stuck around the whole time.
You
could have just gone home on your
own, you
know?
choice_data_list: We played more than twice as much as usual today, huh.
We played more than twice as much as usual today, didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Aha, I guess. Thanks for sticking with
me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
This outfit I'm wearing today... It was
actually a
present from Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I was fretting over something small when
she sent
it to me, along with a letter.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"Have more confidence! Do your best to
have fun
and enjoy life," it said.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
That letter was a huge source of
encouragement
for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Remember when I decided to keep
going along
the river?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the old me would have turned
back there.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: But today... I took a step forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
It felt a bit like someone was giving me a
little
push.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
And that's how we ended up here, after
making
all sorts of exciting discoveries
along the way.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Somehow... Wearing this dress makes me
feel like
I could go anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Maybe so.
choice_data_list: Sounds like Ryan's wish came true.
Sounds like Ryan's wish came true.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I wonder. ...I do hope so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I'm glad I've got something
good to
report.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Now I'll be able to deliver a good
report!

What report?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to tell Ryan about everything
that's
happened today.

still
haven't explored that area over
there!

text_block_list.text:
Huh? I'll do nothing of the sort! I know
very well
how to control myself.

Be careful not to get too carried away!

text_block_list.text: Uh oh, perhaps I am getting a little too excited... Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hey, are you listening?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
But... I guess that goes to show how
much fun this
has been. Nothing wrong
with being a bit excited!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Either way, I'm truly pleased to see that
she's
enjoying herself.

that...

for the
experience that way than
through reading a report...

advice! I'll ask
